headline: I kept holding onto who you used to be, but that copy is stale. Time for CACHE INVALIDATION.
caption:
I kept holding onto who you used to be, but that copy is stale. Time for CACHE INVALIDATION.

—
CACHE INVALIDATION: deciding when a stored copy is out of date and has to be thrown away.
